title: MCP server configuration (.mcp.json)
description: Schema for <cwd..git-root>/.mcp.json, plugin .mcp.json files, and the mcpServers object embedded in ~/.claude.json and .cursor/mcp.json. Root type McpConfig has exactly one recognized field, "mcpServers" (serde rename of mcp_servers); any other top-level key is ignored by the loader and is therefore unconstrained here. Each entry under mcpServers is a McpServerConfig: the transport (Stdio or StreamableHttp) is #[serde(flatten)] over an untagged enum, so transport-specific and server-level keys live in the same JSON object. Server sources are merged in order: config.toml seeds the map (enabled=false blocks lower layers) -> plugins (or_insert) -> ~/.claude.json (or_insert) -> .mcp.json (or_insert, team baseline) -> client override (insert, always wins) -> managed header injection. Because the transport enum is untagged and no struct in the chain sets deny_unknown_fields, an object containing both "command" and "url" deserializes successfully as Stdio (the first variant tried; the extra "url" key is simply ignored) -- this schema accepts such documents too, matching that behavior exactly.

mcpServers.description: Map of server name to server config; serde rename of mcp_servers (an IndexMap at runtime, preserving insertion order; immaterial to JSON Schema validation).

stdioTransport.description: Stdio transport variant of the untagged McpServerTransportConfig; matches when "command" is present as a JSON string.

command.description: Executable to launch; the only field on this variant with no serde default, so its presence (as a string) is what makes an object match Stdio under untagged first-match resolution.

args.description: Command-line arguments; defaults to an empty array.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the spawned process; explicit null is accepted via standard Option<HashMap> deserialization.

cwd.description: Working directory for the spawned process. Present in the on-disk MCP JSON format, but not yet forwarded to the ACP stdio server config.

streamableHttpTransport.description: StreamableHttp transport variant of the untagged McpServerTransportConfig; every field has a serde default, so this variant matches virtually any object once Stdio's required "command" is absent -- and an object can still match this variant even while carrying an ill-typed "command" key, since that key is simply an unrecognized/ignored extra property here.

url.description: Canonical key for the endpoint URL; defaults to "" if absent, in which case to_acp_mcp_server treats the server as absent.

urlTemplate.description: Accepted serde alias for "url"; "url" is canonical.

url_template.description: Accepted serde alias for "url"; "url" is canonical.

type.description: Transport hint; "sse" (case-insensitive) selects the SSE client, as does a url ending in "/sse" regardless of this field's value. No other values are validated by serde -- any string is accepted.

bearer_token_env_var.description: Name of the env var read for an "Authorization: Bearer <token>" header.

oauth_client_id.description: OAuth client ID for providers without Dynamic Client Registration.

oauth_client_secret_env_var.description: Name of the env var holding the OAuth client secret.

oauth_scopes.description: OAuth scopes to request during authorization.

mcpJsonOAuthBlock.description: OAuth block for a server's top-level "oauth" field; camelCase on the wire.

clientSecretEnvVar.description: Env var name holding the OAuth client secret.

mcpSetupConfig.description: Setup-flow schema for servers requiring user input before the transport is usable; v0 supports exactly one select field.

fields.description: Setup fields; the resolver currently requires exactly one field of type "select".

variables.description: Derived values keyed by name, substituted into {{name}} templates once setup resolves.

values.description: Accepted serde alias for "variables"; "variables" is canonical.

type.description: Field kind; "select" is the only McpSetupFieldType variant today (rename_all = lowercase).

required.description: Whether the user must supply a value.

mcpSetupOption.description: One selectable option in a setup field.

value.description: Option value, matched against user input and mcpSetupDerivedValue.map keys.

mcpSetupDerivedValue.description: A value derived from a setup field's selected option.

from.description: References a field id declared in the same setup block.

mcpServerEntry.description: One value under mcpServers: McpServerConfig, the flatten of the untagged transport (see stdioTransport/streamableHttpTransport) plus server-level fields declared below.

enabled.description: Whether this server is active; defaults to true. config.toml layer setting this to false blocks lower merge layers from re-enabling the server.

oauth.description: Server-level OAuth block; also settable via the StreamableHttp transport's oauth_client_id/oauth_client_secret_env_var/oauth_scopes fields, which take precedence when both are set.

setup.description: Setup-flow schema gating this server until resolved.

startup_timeout_sec.description: Seconds to wait for the server to start; when unset, falls back to the shell's globally-resolved MCP startup timeout (requirements.toml [mcp].startup_timeout_sec > env > config.toml [mcp] > remote settings), which itself defaults to 30 (DEFAULT_MCP_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_SECS / DEFAULT_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_SECS) when nothing overrides it.

tool_timeout_sec.description: Default per-tool-call timeout in seconds; falls back to 6000 (DEFAULT_TOOL_TIMEOUT_SECS) when unset and no _meta override is present.

tool_timeouts.description: Per-tool timeout overrides in seconds, keyed by tool name; falls back to tool_timeout_sec for tools not listed.

expose_image_base64.description: Also keep raw base64 in tool-result text so agents can forward image bytes via path-based tools; overridden per-call by _meta.mcpConfig.<server>.exposeImageBase64. Defaults to false when unset.
